description: Bulk rehome items between playlists. Mode copy keeps the source intact; mode move removes from source after copying — by playlist position, removing exactly the transferred occurrences and leaving any other copy in the source. Supports dedupe against target and optional name/artist filter. Either side may be named by lane.

dedupe.description: Skip tracks already in target. Default: true

dry_run.description: Preview only: validate inputs and describe exactly what would change without performing it

filter.description: Optional substring filter: only transfer tracks whose name or artist name contains this string (case-insensitive)

max_results.description: Max items to return (default: SPOTIFY_MCP_MAX_ITEMS env or 50)

mode.description: copy = leave source intact; move = remove from source after copy

response_format.description: 'concise' = human prose, 'detailed' = more fields in prose, 'json' = raw API object

scan_cap.description: Maximum source rows to scan; bounded by SPOTIFY_MCP_FETCH_ALL_CAP

source_lane.description: Lane name resolving to the source playlist; provide exactly one of source_playlist_id or source_lane

source_playlist_id.description: Source playlist ID, spotify:playlist: URI, or URL; provide exactly one of source_playlist_id or source_lane

target_lane.description: Lane name resolving to the target playlist; provide exactly one of target_playlist_id or target_lane

target_playlist_id.description: Target playlist ID, spotify:playlist: URI, or URL; provide exactly one of target_playlist_id or target_lane

name: move_items_between_playlists
